notes.title: v1.0 - Release
notes.notes:
That's it, [b]TOP DOG[/b] is officially out of Early Access!

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]New main menu + improved settings/input menus
[*]Finished a bunch of 3d models
[*]Added sound feedback for picking up scraps
[*]Added 'operation time' to victory screen and leaderboards
[/list]

[h3] See you on the leaderboards! 🫡[/h3]

notes.title: SITREP #6 - Update & 'Operations' Preview
notes.notes:
⚠️ [i]v0.92 ETA: Saturday 11th (18th at the latest)[/i]

[h3]What's happening[/h3]
As you can see from the thumbnail, a new enemy is getting ready and as you probably gathered from last update we are going back to a finite number of waves and shorter runs. Your response on last update was very useful and made the decision to switch much easier, [b]Thanks![/b]

[h3]Operations[/h3]
We are going back to short and challenging runs, where TD really shine but this time you will be able to run different 'Operations': each with a different distribution of enemies, difficulty and some special features (such as bonus upgrade at start, more upgrade choices, etc.).

There will be no changes to the daily leaderboard, except for showing on which operation the score was obtained.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42783902/2a15e1cbf79449238333689966f43ed33cf95569.png[/img]
[i]*work in progress: the details shown will probably change, as well as the operations (there will probably be 6 of them)[/i]

[h3]That's it! 🫡[/h3]
